name: oz-startup-brain
description: Oz Startup Brain monorepo: NestJS API (apps/api), shared contracts and generated API client.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ozsb/contracts && npm run build -w @ozsb/api-client && npm run build -w @ozsb/api
scripts.generate: npm run generate -w @ozsb/contracts && npm run build -w @ozsb/contracts && npm run openapi -w @ozsb/api && npm run generate -w @ozsb/api-client
scripts.check:generated: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/src/generated docs/api/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/generated
scripts.check:compat: npm run build -w @ozsb/contracts && node packages/contracts/scripts/check-compat.mjs docs/api/openapi.v1.baseline.json docs/api/openapi.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
